content.text: Digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines face the harsh reality of being locked out by [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-minimum-viable-stack|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processors like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle, which operate in only 46 out of 195 countries on earth. Meanwhile, a PayPal account suspension can leave funds frozen for up to 180 days with no appeal, making it impossible to rely on these platforms for online sales. This leaves a critical gap in the market for a reliable and secure [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide-3|Selling Digital]]-design-assets-crypto-payments-2|infrastructure]] that allows creators to sell digital products without the risk of platform restrictions. That's where COREMERCH comes in, offering a sovereign commerce infrastructure that provides a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, giving creators the freedom to operate independently and securely.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

In contrast to the limited options provided by payment processors, COREMERCH offers a comprehensive suite of tools that enables digital creators to design, document, and deploy their own sovereign digital commerce stacks, complete with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This means that creators can build and customize their own online stores without relying on external platforms, giving them full control over their infrastructure and data. Furthermore, COREMERCH's products, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, provide a turnkey solution that can be deployed in as little as 48 hours, making it easy for creators to get started with their online sales without sacrificing security or reliability.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Unlike payment processors like Stripe and PayPal, which often impose strict restrictions on creators from certain countries, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to operate independently of these limitations. By using cryptocurrencies and decentralized payment processing, COREMERCH enables creators to collect payments from anywhere in the world, without the need for a traditional payment processor. This makes it an ideal solution for creators who operate in restricted countries or regions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, COREMERCH's solution is designed to be fast and efficient, with automatic crypto payment verification and instant product delivery. Additionally, the fees associated with COREMERCH's services are transparent and predictable, with a flat 0.5% fee for all transactions. This means that creators can focus on growing their business without worrying about surprise fees or hidden charges. In contrast, payment processors like PayPal often impose complex and opaque fee structures that can eat into creators' profits.
Stripe's geographic exclusion list is a deliberate infrastructure decision — not a temporary gap waiting to be fixed.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to give creators full ownership and control over their data and infrastructure. This means that creators can customize their online stores and payment processing systems to suit their specific needs, without relying on external platforms. Furthermore, COREMERCH's automation tools enable creators to streamline their sales and delivery processes, making it easier to manage their online business and focus on growth and customer satisfaction.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the choice of infrastructure will depend on the specific needs and goals of each creator. However, for those who operate in restricted countries or regions, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a reliable and secure solution that can help them overcome the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors. By choosing the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can deploy a turnkey solution that includes everything they need to get started with their online sales, including automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Sovereign infrastructure means no single platform decision can cut off your income — the store runs under your own accounts.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
